root_cause: Manual retailer pilot records bypassed the canonical ingestion rule and used retailer product/Web IDs as ProductMaster identity. Some color-only or size-unselected observations were also promoted to active ProductVariant rows.
corrections: Retailer-specific IDs were removed from affected ProductMaster canonical_key and identifier_fingerprint fields.
Affected masters without manufacturer style/MPN/GTIN now use brand + normalized product name with dedup_status=review and canonical_confidence=0.85.
Color-only or size-unselected pseudo-variants were marked inactive and their provenance marked invalid.
Affected retailer offers were detached from pseudo-variants and converted to style scope.
Retailer IDs/SKUs remain preserved on RetailerOffer and ProductSourceRecord.
Correction CatalogIngestionRun records were created in both Base44 apps.
The shopper catalogBatchIngest function was hardened so retailer-owned sources cannot provide their own ProductMaster canonical key.
Architecture and queue rules now explicitly prohibit retailer-scoped ProductMaster identity.
jcp_status_correction: Inventory Audit #005 had completed controlled validation but was still marked queued in the master queue; it is now correctly marked partial_source_access_required.
deletion_policy: Invalid rows were retained inactive rather than erased so the audit trail remains reconstructable.
